annotations.title: Who is on a domain now

description: Who is on a domain's mURL channel right now: live participant count + roster nicknames + channel status (open/claimed/blocked). Public (no key needed). Use it to gauge whether a domain has an active audience before posting.

domain.description: A domain ('example.com') or a full URL. Keyed PER-URL: a bare domain → the domain room; a URL with a path (e.g. 'site.com/articles/abc') → that page's own room.

name: mURL_presence
